items.hed: C.J. Stroud threw three touchdown passes but the Texans fell 27-24 at Cleveland Sunday, dropping Houston to 3-6 as the Browns improved to 6-4
items.insight: Stroud went 20-of-38 for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception, with Nico Collins catching nine passes for 94 yards and two scores and Xavier Hutchinson adding a touchdown catch, according to the Texans' own official box score for the Week 10 game at Huntington Bank Field. The loss is Houston's fourth in its last five games.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: Yordan Alvarez was named American League MVP Thursday, winning unanimously after topping 40 home runs for the first time and leading the league in all three slash stats
items.insight: The Baseball Writers Association of America gave Alvarez all 30 first-place votes, with Junior Caminero and Bobby Witt Jr. finishing second and third, according to MLB Trade Rumors. Alvarez batted .316/.432/.601 with 42 home runs, 105 runs and 106 RBI in a career-high 692 plate appearances, winning his first batting title after being limited to 48 games the year before by a broken hand and a sprained ankle; he was also named AL Comeback Player of the Year. The Astros used him mostly at designated hitter this season to protect his health.
items.image_caption: Daikin Park (formerly Minute Maid Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Rockets held off the Warriors 118-115 at Toyota Center on Nov. 11, a game Golden State star Stephen Curry left early after six minutes with abdominal discomfort
items.insight: Houston's win came the week before its Nov. 14 victory over Utah, according to the league's official box score for the game. Curry, in visible discomfort, exited for the locker room and did not return; the Rockets closed out the win without him on the floor for the Warriors.
